context: The production funnel the learner already ships, formalized. Recall stage vs precision stage and candidate budgeting; cross-encoders (joint attention) vs bi-encoders and rerank depth; hybrid fusion: WHY sparse and dense fail differently, reciprocal rank fusion vs score normalization, and "The Atrium Pattern" topic = the learner's own production architecture (BM25 + dense vectors + RRF + reranker) analyzed as a general pattern; learned sparse retrieval (SPLADE term expansion + impact weights, doc2query document expansion, impact-sorted indexes, shipped systems like ELSER/neural sparse) framed as neural models running on the SAME inverted index from IR 101; late interaction (ColBERT token-level matching, PLAID serving) and cross-encoder distillation as one "beyond the cross-encoder" lesson.
